narr: Thunderstorms developed along a stationary front over the area on August 23rd. These thunderstorms were slow moving and produced heavy rainfall over Connecticut. The thunderstorms developed in an environment with 1.5 to 1.7 inches of precipitable water and CAPE values of 1500 - 2000 J/kg. The thunderstorms produced locally up to 2 to 3 inches of rain in a 2 hour period.
ev: Multiple road closures across Waterbury due to flooding.
Northbound 22 entrance ramp to Route 8 in Seymour CT impassible due to flooding.
Route 8 northbound closed between exits 22 and 23 because of water on road.
